List

Universal lists can cleanly and efficiently hold elements such as text, lists, images, and paragraphs (minimum version: 25.12.0).

Sample Code

Basic Usage


<maui-list header='Basic Usage' radius footer='Top Description'>
  <maui-list-item>1</maui-list-item>
  <maui-list-item>2</maui-list-item>
  <maui-list-item>3</maui-list-item>
</maui-list>

List Item Basic Properties


<maui-list-item arrow='right'>arrow right</maui-list-item>
<maui-list-item arrow='up'>arrow up</maui-list-item>
<maui-list-item brief='second line of information'>brief</maui-list-item>
<maui-list-item disabled>disabled</maui-list-item>

Extended Attribute Usage


<maui-list header='list-item Additional Information'>
  <maui-list-item extra='Extra content on the right' extraBrief='Auxiliary information on the right'>Information display
    on the right
  </maui-list-item>
  <maui-list-item showDivider='false'>No underscores</maui-list-item>
  <maui-list-item image='https://example/img/logo.png'>Insert picture</maui-list-item>
  <maui-list-item title='I am the title'>Title information</maui-list-item>
  <maui-list-item title='Slot'>
    <maui-button>insert button</maui-button>
  </maui-list-item>
</maui-list>

API

List

Attribute Description Type Default Value
footer Bottom Description String -
header Head Description String -
radius Whether with rounded corners Boolean false

ListItem

Attribute Description Type Default Value
arrow The right arrow can be set to right, up, or down. Passing true will return right. String | Boolean -
brief Second line of information String -
disabled Whether to disable Boolean false
extra Extra content on the right String -
extraBrief Auxiliary information on the right String -
image Picture on the left String -
radius Whether with rounded corners Boolean false
showDivider Show underline or not Boolean true
title Header Information String -

ListItem Slot

Name Description
- Custom form field content
